changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: update users set permissions = replace(permissions, 'PERM_BUDGET_DEFINITION', 'BUDGET_DEFINITION') where permissions like '%PERM_BUDGET_DEFINITION%';
update users set permissions = replace(permissions, 'PERM_BUDGET_NOMENCLATURE', 'BUDGET_NOMENCLATURE') where permissions like '%PERM_BUDGET_NOMENCLATURE%';

rollback.sql: update users set permissions = replace(permissions, 'BUDGET_DEFINITION', 'PERM_BUDGET_DEFINITION') where permissions like '%BUDGET_DEFINITION%';
update users set permissions = replace(permissions, 'BUDGET_NOMENCLATURE', 'PERM_BUDGET_NOMENCLATURE') where permissions like '%BUDGET_NOMENCLATURE%';
